title: 1% SDS in DNA Buffer Preparation
author: Andrew Baker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.dys7wd
materials: Mix 50 mL 4 M NaCl and 50 mL 0.5 M EDTA.
Mix 50 mL 4 M NaCl and 50 mL 0.5 M EDTA

steps.title: Prepare 4 M NaCl stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve sodium chloride (catalog P212121) in MilliQ water to make a 4 M NaCl stock solution.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 M EDTA stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) in MilliQ water to make a 0.5 M EDTA stock solution.

steps.title: Adjust volume to 500 mL
steps.instruction: Add the prepared NaCl and EDTA stocks as needed, then add MilliQ water to bring the total volume to 500 mL.

steps.title: Dissolve SDS to 1 % w/v
steps.instruction: Add SDS (catalog P212121) to the DNA buffer to a final concentration of 1 % (w/v); for example, dissolve 5 g SDS in 500 mL of the buffer.
